meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按统一契约搭建可稳定渲染的动画合成项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用标记语言制作动画或视频,需要每次渲染结果一致。
copy.tagline_en: Build animation compositions that render identically on every run
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you author animation or video in markup and need consistent renders

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 的合成契约写可渲染的 HTML 项目:用 data-* 属性声明时间、每个合成注册一个暂停的 GSAP 时间线、媒体播放交给框架,并跑 lint、check、render 做校验与出片。
howto.when: 当你准备写合成 HTML,或要处理 data-* 时间属性、class="clip"、轨道等结构时接管;原文要求写 composition HTML 之前先读它。

say.text: 帮我搭一个最小的可渲染合成骨架
say.note: 会给出 index.html 骨架并说明根节点要求

say.text: 检查这个合成为什么 lint 报错
say.note: 会跑 check 并列出具体错误项

say.text: 给这个合成加一段定时播放的音频

howto.what_en: Claude writes renderable HTML composition projects under the HyperFrames contract: timing declared with data-* attributes, one paused GSAP timeline per composition, framework-owned media playback, plus lint/check/render validation.
howto.when_en: Use before writing composition HTML, or when working on composition structure, data-* timing attributes, class="clip", tracks, sub-compositions, variables, determinism rules, or validation.

say_en.text: Scaffold the smallest renderable composition skeleton
say_en.note: Gives an index.html skeleton with root requirements

say_en.text: Check why this composition fails lint
say_en.note: Runs check and lists the failing rules

say_en.text: Add a timed audio clip to this composition
